title: Q-YEAR-offsite-backup: export D1 to R2 daily and bind the audit sink
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `offsite-backup` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe offsite-backup
**Status:** closed

Create an R2 bucket for backups, bind it on the tick Worker in doctrine/topology.json, export each D1 database daily with a restore drill once a week, and bind the AUDIT sink so sealed audit segments have two homes.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that resolves.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 23.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
